command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=bc486c19f93d7ae1be202c30466c7ba1972aac62
BRANCH=chatgpt-omega-fred-088-tree-closure-v2-20260913
D=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
git clone -q --branch "$BRANCH" https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/self-integration.git "$D/repo"
cd "$D/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''def condition(*, config: Path = CONFIG, durable_root: Path = DURABLE_ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    obj = load_cutover(durable_root)
    if obj.get("state") != "LIVE_VERIFIED" or not obj.get("live_bind_verified"):
        return False, "semantic tree live cutover not sealed"
    verify_binds(config, durable_root)
    verify_durable_manifest(obj, durable_root)
    return True, "durable semantic tree verified"
'''
new='''def validate_live_seal_record(obj: dict[str, Any], durable_root: Path = DURABLE_ROOT) -> None:
    """Require persisted evidence emitted by a successful ``seal-live``.

    LIVE_VERIFIED is not accepted as a naked mutable flag. This is an integrity
    fence against partial or accidental manifest promotion, not a security
    boundary against root.
    """
    if obj.get("state") != "LIVE_VERIFIED" or obj.get("live_bind_verified") is not True:
        fail("semantic tree live cutover not sealed")
    if obj.get("restart_authorized") is not False or obj.get("vm_restarted") is not False:
        fail("live seal carries invalid restart state")
    if obj.get("source_deleted_or_moved") is not False:
        fail("live seal reports source deletion/move")
    prepared = obj.get("prepared_unix")
    sealed = obj.get("sealed_unix")
    if isinstance(prepared, bool) or isinstance(sealed, bool) or not isinstance(prepared, (int, float)) or not isinstance(sealed, (int, float)) or sealed < prepared:
        fail("live seal timestamp evidence missing/invalid")
    leader = obj.get("container_leader")
    if isinstance(leader, bool) or not isinstance(leader, int) or leader <= 0:
        fail("live seal container leader missing/invalid")
    proof = obj.get("mount_proof")
    if not isinstance(proof, list) or len(proof) != len(PROTECTED):
        fail("live seal mount proof missing/incomplete")
    by_namespace: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for rec in proof:
        if not isinstance(rec, dict):
            fail("live seal mount proof record invalid")
        namespace = rec.get("namespace")
        if not isinstance(namespace, str) or namespace in by_namespace:
            fail("live seal mount proof namespace invalid/duplicate")
        by_namespace[namespace] = rec
    for _source_rel, durable_rel in PROTECTED:
        namespace = durable_rel.name
        rec = by_namespace.get(namespace)
        if rec is None:
            fail(f"live seal missing namespace proof: {namespace}")
        durable = durable_root / durable_rel
        inside = Path(f"/proc/{leader}/root/root/.local/share") / durable_rel
        if rec.get("durable") != str(durable) or rec.get("container_view") != str(inside):
            fail(f"live seal path proof mismatch: {namespace}")
        inode = rec.get("dev_inode")
        if (not isinstance(inode, list) or len(inode) != 2 or
                any(isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int) or x < 0 for x in inode)):
            fail(f"live seal inode proof invalid: {namespace}")


def condition(*, config: Path = CONFIG, durable_root: Path = DURABLE_ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    obj = load_cutover(durable_root)
    if obj.get("state") != "LIVE_VERIFIED" or not obj.get("live_bind_verified"):
        return False, "semantic tree live cutover not sealed"
    validate_live_seal_record(obj, durable_root)
    verify_binds(config, durable_root)
    verify_durable_manifest(obj, durable_root)
    return True, "durable semantic tree verified with persisted live-seal proof"
'''
assert s.count(old)==1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=Path('werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover_selbsttest.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    obj = m.load_cutover(durable)
    obj["state"] = "LIVE_VERIFIED"
    obj["live_bind_verified"] = True
    m.write_manifest(obj, durable)
    ok, reason = m.condition(config=config, durable_root=durable)
    assert ok and "verified" in reason
'''
new='''    obj = m.load_cutover(durable)
    obj["state"] = "LIVE_VERIFIED"
    obj["live_bind_verified"] = True
    m.write_manifest(obj, durable)
    try:
        m.condition(config=config, durable_root=durable)
    except m.CutoverError as exc:
        assert "seal" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("naked LIVE_VERIFIED flags bypassed seal-live evidence")
    leader = 4242
    obj["sealed_unix"] = float(obj["prepared_unix"]) + 1.0
    obj["container_leader"] = leader
    obj["mount_proof"] = []
    for _source_rel, durable_rel in m.PROTECTED:
        d = durable / durable_rel
        obj["mount_proof"].append({
            "namespace": durable_rel.name,
            "durable": str(d),
            "container_view": str(Path(f"/proc/{leader}/root/root/.local/share") / durable_rel),
            "dev_inode": [d.stat().st_dev, d.stat().st_ino],
        })
    m.write_manifest(obj, durable)
    ok, reason = m.condition(config=config, durable_root=durable)
    assert ok and "persisted live-seal proof" in reason
'''
assert s.count(old)==1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
python3 -m py_compile werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover.py werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover_selbsttest.py
python3 werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover_selbsttest.py
git diff --check
git fetch -q origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED" || { echo SOURCE_DRIFT; exit 43; }
git add werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover.py werkzeug/semantic-tree-cutover_selbsttest.py
git commit -q -m '088/FRED: require persisted seal-live mount proof'
NEW=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git push -q origin HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH
READBACK=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/$BRANCH | awk '{print $1}')
echo NEW=$NEW
echo READBACK=$READBACK
test "$READBACK" = "$NEW"
echo FRED_PR12_SEAL_ATTESTATION_REPAIR_PASS
